ALL 14 confirmed are in `houses/code/armory`. My earlier "113-page defect" framing was WRONG —
113 is the population sharing the pattern, not the count of broken pages.

ROOT CAUSE: `LinuxTerminal` HAS a correct mechanism — `_checkObjective` is called from 35 sites,

**Armory bypassed it and rolled its own typed-text matching.**
